care.summary: Striking succulent with upright cylindrical leaves; extremely drought-tolerant and virtually indestructible.
care.light: Bright indirect to low light; tolerates shade
care.water: Water sparingly; allow soil to dry completely between waterings
care.soil: Very well-draining cactus or succulent mix
care.humidity: Low to average; tolerates dry air
care.fertilizer: Dilute balanced fertilizer once in spring and summer
care.toxicity: Mildly toxic to pets if ingested
common_issues: Brown leaf tips from fluoride in tap water
tips: Use unglazed clay pots to prevent overwatering
Propagate by leaf cuttings or division
